Orc Outrider (CV 12)

A strong, long-legged orc scout with weathered travel gear and a well-kept blade. This profile represents an outrider on foot, accustomed to protecting a moving caravan or border patrol.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +1; Agility +1; Guile +0; Knowledge +0; Reason +0

HP: 15 · Speed: 7 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 0

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: None\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Clearing stroke

The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Push 2. Standard defense: Push 1.

Study the Opening

It waits for a tell in the stance, then turns its attention to the exposed line.

Its next attack before the end of this turn imposes 1 additional Bane on player defense, or gains 1 Boon when player-controlled. One attack only; no stacking with itself.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: A watch camp has been cleared without disturbing the surrounding brush.

Purpose: Keep strangers away from the caravan or homeland under their protection.

Tactics and retreat: Push a pursuer from a choke point, then move back to support the patrol.

Counterplay and conversation: Identify the real threat to the patrol’s charges or agree to a supervised passage.

Habitat: Steppe; border road · Communication: Common and Orc

Loot: Melee weapon, travel food d6 and 7 coins; no mount included in this profile.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 3/4/6

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.2

Action review (#1279): U 1.15 → 1.2: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=5.000, O=3.653. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
